question: dame la tasa de aprobación en porcentaje de cada esquema de tarjeta, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql: SELECT card_scheme, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS approval_rate_pct FROM fact_payment_attempt GROUP BY card_scheme ORDER BY approval_rate_pct DESC
